dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}. Fancy running into you here.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I was just out patrolling the area, cleaning up a spot of Wild Hunt unpleasantness, and now here you are.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: This is quite a ways from town, and the area's teeming with monsters and the Wild Hunt. If you need me to escort you back, I'd be more than happy to oblige.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Ah, I see. In that case, I'd better not distract you.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Hehe, well said — and I have witnessed your skills already.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: But it would be rude not to make the offer, having found you alone in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Anyway, I'd best be going. If you do find yourself in need of help, you know where to find me. I'll always be ready to answer when you come knocking on my door.

choices.text: I don't encounter danger — danger encounters me!
I have a few things to take care of first.
